title: Wi-Fi Standards Primer
scenario: Welcome to Wi-Fi Standards Primer. Before proceeding, you must master these essential networking terms. Wi-Fi Protected Access 2 (WPA2): IEEE 802.11i. Personal (PSK) or Enterprise (802.1X/RADIUS). Uses AES-CCMP encryption. Vulnerable to PMKID/dictionary attacks on PSK. Superseded by WPA3 but still widely deployed. Wi-Fi Protected Access 3 (WPA3): Latest Wi-Fi security standard. Replaces PSK with SAE (Simultaneous Authentication of Equals) — protects against offline dictionary attacks. Mandatory for Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) devices.
question: What does WPA2 stand for?
explanation: WPA2 stands for Wi-Fi Protected Access 2.
